notes: English distinguishes the alchemical plant Sativa Stalk/Stalks from Sativa Fibers and from the named Sativa Road and Sativa Road Amulet. Base:2397 and default:7247/59501 identify the stalk; Japanese サティヴァの茎 and Chinese 亚麻秆 corroborate. Base:3344, default:17582/29183/62452 identify a road crossing dangerous mountains and its named amulet, corroborated by Japanese サティヴァの道/サティヴァの道のアミュレット and Chinese 亚麻路/亚麻路护符. Reuse 사티바 줄기, 사티바 길, and 사티바 길의 부적. Singular/plural English stalk labels are paired locally, without changing the Korean noun's number. The official Korean manual PDF p. 8 distinguishes gathered reagents from crafting outputs; p. 6 distinguishes inventory items. It does not name this plant or road. Preserve the existing Sativa Fibers dispositions and other names on these rows; do not register a global bare Sativa alias.
